reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin suite for automated health monitoring, closed-loop repair and escalation, trust-based multi-agent delegation, anomaly insight mining, and persistent knowledge transfer.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供健康监控、闭环修复与升级、基于信任的多智能体派发、异常洞察和知识沉淀能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with health monitoring, closed-loop repair and escalation, trust-based multi-agent delegation, anomaly insights, and persistent knowledge transfer.

capabilities: Collects health and resource metrics and emits status events
Automatically selects strategies and applies reversible repair actions
Escalates failed repairs and emits alerts for human intervention
Delegates work to other nodes using trust thresholds and capability matching
Detects error patterns and generates periodic or offline insights
Persists versioned knowledge, trust data, and evolution milestones
Provides health, repair, trust, delegation, insight, remember, and recall tools
Displays metrics through a shell overlay dashboard
